name: Welcome Home
overview: The theme of 'Welcome Home' in Scripture reveals the beauty of receiving and caring for others as Christ has received us, exemplified in Romans 15:7 and Matthew 25:35. Faithfulness and righteousness are honored, as seen in Proverbs 16:31 and Matthew 25:23, where entering into the joy of the Lord is promised to those who live faithfully. Hospitality and generosity toward fellow believers are commanded in Romans 12:13, reflecting the heart of Christ's welcoming nature. Even Jesus’ journey through places like Jericho (Luke 19:1) reminds us of His willingness to enter into the lives of those in need, inviting them into His presence and family.
